provider: China Unicom Cloud (联通云盘 / 沃盘, pan.wo.cn)

free_tier.stated: 60 GB free, raised from 10 GB by a promotion from 2025-09-01 to 15 that was made permanent: '免费用户存储空间 由10GB 提升至60GB，空间长期有效'. Non-Unicom numbers can register

per_object_cap.stated: Not published in what was read

retention.stated: The 60 GB is stated as 长期有效, long-term valid. Promotional grants of 8 TB run one year

egress.terms: Advertised 不限速 on the homepage. One poster measured cross-carrier throughput through OpenList and WebDAV at their full 100 Mbit/s up and 500 Mbit/s down, so unlike Tianyi it is not throttled cross-carrier

tooling: the OpenList wopan driver, which has its own maintained SDK at OpenListTeam/wopan-sdk-go with refresh-token and family-id support. That makes it maintained rather than reverse-engineered, which is unusual for a Chinese carrier drive
chaining: 60 GB per account and phone-bound, so each additional carrier number is a new identity. Carrier family sharing pools within a household. Not a 500 GB play without multiplication

limits.value: 60 GB is the free tier total, which is the cap in practice
registration wants a Unicom number or a promo code; a non-Unicom number is accepted but still a Chinese one

identity_cost.detail: a PRC number, with a non-Unicom number accepted: '非联通用户也能注册'. A promo code is the alternative path

reliability_note: The quota is promotional and has already changed once, and the operator drives historically shrink free tiers after a growth phase. Multiple posters describe the product as under-resourced with a slow interface, and the WebDAV mount and the cross-network speed are the best of the three carrier pans

evidence.proved: '免费用户存储空间 由10GB 提升至60GB，空间长期有效' and '非联通用户也能注册'
homepage title '联通云盘-开启美好时光|不限速', and '非联通用户也能注册'
'可以送8T的存储空间...本人通过Openlist挂载webdav实测，能够跑满我的100Mbps上传和500Mbps下载...会员有效期1年'
'我是永久2T，办套餐送的', so permanent capacity rides a plan
the web client actively blocks F12 inspection: '这个打开F12 会自动屏蔽'
The site answered a title through another path, so the DNS result is vantage-dependent and not a death

binding_note: 60 GB free is 12% of the filter and the large grants are time-limited plan benefits. The per-file cap is unpublished, so the account total is what binds, and 60 GB does not reach the filter at any identity cost.
notes: A carrier pan whose WebDAV mount is maintained rather than reverse-engineered, which makes it the most stable of the three and the smallest. Both are right about different tiers, and the verdict follows the permanent tier because the promo is time-limited.
